$comment: Authoritative attestation reference for the production publicai-gateway CVM (sub2api single-enclave architecture). Fetched at runtime by the /proof page (see frontend/src/utils/attestation/reference.ts). Every change to this file is public git history — that is part of the trust story. composeHash was read back from the CVM's RTMR3 via the attestor's event log on 2026-07-29 and cross-checked against the Phala control-plane API; both report aff1eef4. Image digests are the linux/amd64 children of the cosign-signed proof-v12 indexes built from sourceCommit by publish-tee-images (run 30417873445). proof-v12 fixes CVE-2026-22696 (GHSA-796p-j2gh-9m2q, CVSS 9.3) in /proof's own verifier: the previous @phala/dcap-qvl-web package never verified the QE Identity signature, so a quote could carry an unauthenticated quoting enclave and still be reported as verified. The verifier is now @phala/dcap-qvl, which performs that check; a regression test pins the behaviour against a real nonce-bound quote captured from this attestor. Honest note on the publish window: unlike the proof-v11 upgrade, composeHash was NOT predicted ahead of the deploy this time — the app-compose.json wrapper returned by the API no longer reproduces the live hash under the CLI's serialization, so the value could only be read back afterwards. Between the CVM update and this commit, /proof therefore reported a mismatch against this file as a failed enclave. osImageHash and appId are unchanged, so the enclave's E2EE public key, derived from the app key, is also unchanged.
